text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While watching TV with Hishi Akebono, a 
commercial aired showing a scene from a 
famous fairy tale about a girl wandering 
into a wonderland.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Alice! How nostalgic~! I really 
looked up to her when I was little~
choice_data_list: You looked up to me? Why?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know that part of the story where 
Alice shrinks? She gets so small she could 
fit right on your palm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I just thought it'd be super fun♪ 
Floating in a sea of chanko stew, or 
taking giant bites out of a whole mountain 
of cake!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All the things you love get suuuuper big! 
Don't you think that's the greatest thing 
ever?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A world where everything is big... If 
that's the case!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Hishi Akebono to an art museum. 
It's a rather unique spot with numerous 
giant exhibits lined up outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~! That teapot over there is huge~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how many meters tall it is? Even 
if there were two of me stacked up, I 
might not reach it~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there's something over there too! A 
giant chair? Cake? What is all of this? 
I'm curious about everything~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eep, Trainer, look, look! That kitty looks 
like a truck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm under such a huge body, they might 
plop down and sit on me without even 
noticing!"
choice_data_list: Being this big, it looks really strong!
Being this big, it looks really strong!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, so big and sturdy, they seem totally 
dependable~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Huge... playing cards!? It kinda 
looks like a bed!
choice_data_list:
Apparently you can lie down on the top 
bunk too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, well then... pardon the intrusion~ 
Up we go♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, so waaaarm. I feel like I'm gonna 
melt right away~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, this solid "wham" feeling... It 
kinda makes me feel protected~..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Right now, I really feel like 
Alice♪ Hey, hey, where should we check out 
next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then—a young boy came dashing over. 
Not looking where he was going, he ran 
straight toward Hishi Akebono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Kya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I bumped into you. Are you 
okay? You're not hurt, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Hishi Akebono reached out her hand, 
the boy looked up at her intently. Then, 
as he stood up...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
...Waah! It's huuuuge!! Whoa... 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"It's like... it's like a gigantic 
mountain! All big and BOOM... so cool, so 
cool!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~... thank you♪♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Do I really look that big to you? Hehe... 
that kind of tickles!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna be just like Big Sis too! I wanna 
be huge and look super strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you eat plenty without being picky, 
you'll grow big and strong. I'm sure of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bit tired from all the walking, I 
decided to take a break at the museum 
cafe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today was so much fun~. I got to see so 
many big things!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I looked up with a 'woooow', I felt 
like I was getting smaller and smaller, it 
felt kind of magical!
choice_data_list: I think I get what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if that's why? The girl who 
bumped into me earlier had sparkling eyes 
too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You must've seen me as big as that kitty 
cat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So big, so imposing. They looked up to me 
and wanted to be just like that—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Being big has always just been "normal" 
for me, but... today feels a little 
different somehow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe my "bigness", just like 
this sculpture, could move the hearts of 
those who see it too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to get much, muuuuch bigger so 
I can reach out to everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Giving everyone an excitement bigger than 
anyone else's, the kind that makes them go 
"Whoaaa...!"☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Hishi Akebono smile so innocently 
made me want to help spread that "Big 
Excitement" with her.
choice_data_list:
Let's deliver that big excitement 
together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! ...Fufu♪ Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before heading back to the academy, we 
stopped by Hishi Akebono's favorite 
restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna get big, eating plenty of 
food is the most important thing, after 
all~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Time to recharge your energy with buono 
food! You've gotta eat up big too, 
Trainer~♪
choice_data_list: Leave it to me. I'll keep up with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking about our dreams of making it big, 
Hishi Akebono and I enjoyed a hearty meal 
together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get a souvenir to remember today 
by~ Hmm, which one should I pick?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A giant rice cracker, a giant keychain... 
Woah, even a giant jigsaw puzzle!
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, there are so many options it's hard 
to choose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughing together about what would be 
nice, the two of them chose souvenirs at 
the museum shop.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, starting tomorrow, I'll keep aiming 
to become a "big and buono" me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I raised my fist together with Hishi 
Akebono. With great ambition held close to 
our hearts, we set off on the walk back to 
the Academy.
